activity_summary: You came home before noon, by way of every wall, after the armour-basket. Mistress Ansell sent Alse for the bay grease your mother put in the pack, and sent you up. You are not cast this afternoon.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Came home by every wall, and went up.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Sent for the jar, and sent him upstairs.

facets.activity: Came home by way of every wall

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: Shall I fetch the little pot of bay grease your mother put in your pack
